summary: On-page audit inspected 1 indexable pages. Discovered 3 issues with score 77/100.

findings.title: Missing Title Tags
findings.impact: Title tags are the primary on-page signal for relevance in SERP snippets.
findings.recommendation: Provide unique, compelling title tags between 50-60 characters for all pages.

findings.title: Missing Meta Descriptions
findings.impact: Search engines will generate arbitrary text snippets from page content, hurting SERP CTR.
findings.recommendation: Write unique, persuasive meta descriptions (120-160 characters) with a clear call to action.

findings.title: Missing OpenGraph Metadata
findings.description: Pages lack `og:title`, `og:description`, and `og:image` tags for social sharing previews.
findings.impact: Links shared on Twitter, LinkedIn, Slack, and Facebook will display unoptimized generic cards.
findings.recommendation: Implement OpenGraph meta tags on all public landing pages and articles.
